Results.ReviewText:
This grill lasted 3.5 years, but only because I dragged it across the finish line for the last year+.
Admittedly, I grill a lot - about 6x per week. In the 3.5 years I had it, I replaced the flavorizer bars 4 or 5 times and it probably should have been twice that many. The temperature gauge stopped working about 2 years in. I got used to where the hot spots were and worked around them. The burners literally fell apart and had to be replaced which was NOT easy to do as the screws were warped from the heat. And then a few days ago, the metal supports holding up the pan under the burners broke and the pan fell out of the bottom rendering it basically unusable because the grill is on patio pavers and I can’t have all that grease falling onto them that the pan would normally catch.
All that said, I liked the grill. I decided to buy another Weber, just larger and with more BTU’s and thankfully, the new one doesn’t have a burner tube running along the back of the grill creating hot spots.
Given that I probably used it 1000 times or more, I feel like I got my money’s worth out of it and that’s why I’m not filing a warranty claim (just because you can doesn’t mean you should) as the warranty supposedly covers the major issues I described up to 5 years.
Would I have liked it to last longer? Of course. But I used it A LOT and can’t complain too awful much. It’s a solid little grill that will last most people a very long time.
Results.Title: Lasted 3.5 years before failing completely

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
